# Copilot Agent Skill Usage Guide

## Purpose

This file maps the agent skills available to contributors on the `develop` branch to the situations where they should be invoked. It covers the two skills shipped with this branch: `agent-provenance-detector` (AI authorship detection) and `skill-template` (contributor checklist for creating new skills).

For the full skill guide including UI, GSD, and platform skills, see the `testing-main` branch.

## How to read this file

- Each section describes one skill: when to call it, trigger phrases, and the run commands.
- Keep skill definitions under `.agents/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` up-to-date; Copilot can inspect those files for technical details.

## Available Skills

### `agent-provenance-detector`

**Purpose:** Detect whether a source file was authored or assisted by a coding agent (Copilot, Claude, GPT, etc.) and emit confidence-scored provenance evidence.

**When to call:**

- "Detect whether this file was generated by Copilot or another agent"
- "Run provenance detection on staged files before commit"
- "Append agent author metadata if an LLM produced this code"

**Run — single file:**

```
python scripts/detect_agent_provenance.py path/to/file.py
```

**Run — all staged files** (same as what the pre-commit hook calls):

```
python scripts/append_provenance.py
```

Full skill definition: `.agents/skills/agent-provenance-detector/SKILL.md`

---

### `skill-template`

**Purpose:** Contributor checklist and SKILL.md boilerplate for creating new agent skills.

**When to reference:** Any time you are adding a new skill under `.agents/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md`. Copy the template, fill in the required front-matter (`name`, `description`) and the mandatory sections (When to Use, Trigger Phrases, Install / Run), then work through the quality checklist.

**Source:** `.agents/skills/skill-template/SKILL.md`

---

## Pre-commit integration

The pre-commit hook (`hooks/pre-commit`) automatically runs provenance detection on every commit:

```
hooks/pre-commit
  └─ scripts/append_provenance.py      ← iterates staged files
       └─ scripts/detect_agent_provenance.py  ← heuristic detector per file
```

**Install the hook:**

```bash
# Linux / macOS
bash hooks/install_hook.sh

# Windows
hooks\install_hook.bat
```

After installation, `append_provenance.py` runs on every `git commit` and appends `Author:` metadata to files where an AI signal is detected.
